description: DEUS tuning for the spell-effect layer (SIM.60.02). Coefficients are per damage type or per effect kind, never per spell (audit section 3.5). Every entry has a value (or null), a unit, a status and a source. Numbers owned by a sibling design are cited, not copied, so there is one source of truth (AGENTS Rule 14). Owner questions are held as data with no value chosen.

statuses.PM_DEFAULT: A default the PM or a reviewed design supplies; the Owner may change it.
statuses.OWNER_OPEN: An open Owner question decides it; the value is null until the Owner answers.
statuses.PLACEHOLDER: Needed by SIM.60.03 but not yet set; value null or a provisional value named as such. Set with the owning design on the SIM.60.04 fixtures.
statuses.PM_DEFAULT_UNCONFIRMED: The PM default for DEC-018's open sub-question (conjured matter), not confirmed by the Owner (docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.md:262).

conjuredMatterPolicy.question: Q1
conjuredMatterPolicy.authority: DEC-018 open sub-question with its PM default (docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.md:262): conjured matter is an explicitly modelled magical source or sink, logged like rain and evaporation. game/js/sim/ledger_defaults.js declares sources.magic and sinks.magic with ownerConfirmed false. Effects name a case below; the runtime takes the source and sink names from the case, so an Owner ruling changes only this table.

options.A: PM default: conjured matter is an explicit magical source or sink with a named cause (spell:<id>), logged in the ledger like rain and evaporation; temporary matter has a paired sink at the end.
options.B: Borrowed matter: conjured matter is drawn from the surroundings within a radius as a transform; the spell fails or shrinks if there is not enough.
options.C: Temporary only: all conjured matter is magical and vanishes at the end; permanence clauses become magical permanence outside Q-MASS until dispelled.
options.D: Outside the ledger: magic is exempt from LIFE-001 (the ledger ignores spell matter).
options.E: Hybrid: permanent matter is an A-style source; temporary matter is a magical form outside Q-MASS until it becomes permanent, tracked by provenance so the sink always finds it.

permanent.covers: Permanent conjured matter and permanent removal: Create or Destroy Water, Create Food and Water, Goodberry, a permanent Wall of Stone, Plant Growth's overgrowth.

temporaryLeavesArea.covers: Temporary conjured matter that can leave its area or change form before the spell ends (flood water, melt from ice walls and hail, storm rain, Creation's objects, feast food, conjured plants, web, grease).
options: the paired sink follows the matter by provenance
the matter left outside the area stays
temporaryLeavesArea.note: If the matter becomes permanent under its spell's own rule (Wall of Stone held for the whole duration), the paired sink is cancelled and the permanent case applies.

massChangeOfBodies.covers: Mass changes of bodies and objects: Enlarge/Reduce, petrification, polymorph and shapechange forms, and new or restored bodies (Clone, Reincarnate, Resurrection, True Resurrection, Regenerate).
options: the ledger tracks creature tissue and the SRD weight bears on floors
creature tissue is outside the ledger; the SRD weight still bears on floors

planarTransfer.covers: Planar travel and extradimensional storage: Secret Chest's permanent loss, Demiplane and Magnificent Mansion contents, Rope Trick, Imprisonment's hedged prison, the violet prismatic ray.
options: ledger import and export with a named cause
a held form inside the ledger

summonedBodies.covers: Summoned creatures that disappear without remains (Conjure Animals, Find Familiar, Find Steed, the elementals, Insect Plague's swarm).
options: a magic source and paired sink
Conjure Elemental consumes the matter it rises from
summonedBodies.note: No effect record uses this case: the summoning spells are NONE in the audit. The row exists so the policy is complete.

Q1.title: Conjured matter and the conservation ledger (DEC-018 open sub-question)
Q1.source: docs/audits/SRD_SPELL_EFFECT_AUDIT.md sections 5 and 6 (Q1 parts a-e); docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.md:262

permanent.asks: Q1(a): is permanent conjured matter a named ledger source, and are there limits?

temporaryLeavesArea.asks: Q1(b): does the paired sink follow temporary matter that left its area or changed form (provenance), leave it behind, or does it become permanent?

massChangeOfBodies.asks: Q1(c): does the ledger track creature tissue, and does the SRD weight apply to floor load?

planarTransfer.asks: Q1(d): are planar travel and extradimensional storage ledger imports and exports?

summonedBodies.asks: Q1(e): are summoned bodies outside Q-MASS, and does Conjure Elemental consume the matter it rises from?

finiteFamilyMatter.asks: Q1(a) and Q1(b) for finite families: Creation's precious metals, gems, adamantine and mithral, and Wish's object, would be new metal or gem matter; the ledger defaults refuse a magic source for finite families and LIFE-002 forbids ore. May a spell create them, and how?
options: yes, as a temporary magic source with provenance and a paired sink

Q2.title: Time scale for spell durations
Q2.source: docs/audits/SRD_SPELL_EFFECT_AUDIT.md sections 6 and 7; tasks/SIM.60.01/lane-p/escalation.md (four sources disagree)

secondsPerTick.asks: How many game seconds does one simulation tick represent for action-domain and for historical-domain spell lifetimes?
options: the world clock of DEUS_Core.js:59-61 and ADR-003 Rev 2 section 3.2
the VISION V46 and V101 beat

actionClock.asks: Do SRD rounds and minutes run on a separate action clock, or on the one world clock (V101)?

Q3.title: Physical effects for damage types DEC-018 does not name

acidCorrosion.asks: Does acid corrode materials? The SRD damages objects with acid only in Storm of Vengeance's rain.
options: no physical effect beyond the SRD

lightningConduction.asks: Does lightning conduct through water or metal? The SRD's only metal rule is Shocking Grasp's advantage against metal armour.

necroticPlants.asks: Do necrotic areas kill plants (for example Circle of Death)?

radiantPlants.asks: Do radiant damage and spell sunlight affect plants?

thunderStructures.asks: Does thunder damage structures beyond Shatter and Thunderwave?

Q4.title: SRD-silent properties of magical substances and barriers
Q4.source: docs/audits/SRD_SPELL_EFFECT_AUDIT.md section 6 (Q4) and the records that cite it

entangleBurns.asks: Do Entangle's conjured weeds and vines burn?

thornsBurn.asks: Does Wall of Thorns' brush burn?

magicalFireFuel.asks: Does magical fire (Wall of Fire, Flaming Sphere, Fire Shield, Produce Flame, Flame Blade) consume fuel, leave ash, or light tinder?

forceBearsLoad.asks: Does a horizontal Wall of Force, a Forcecage or a Resilient Sphere bear load?

reverseGravityFluids.asks: Does Reverse Gravity lift loose water?

flamingSphereFalls.asks: Does Flaming Sphere fall into a shaft it is rolled over?

sphereFallsWithFloor.asks: Does a weightless Resilient Sphere fall when the floor under it collapses?
